name: hedged_one
paragraphs: One may nevertheless hesitate before identifying melatonin onset with circadian phase itself.
The assay is peripheral; it is also sensitive to posture, to residual light, and to caffeine history.
If one prefers a more conservative reading, the same numbers support only a narrower claim about a movable evening rise.
A single delayed sample does not, by itself, licence a strong claim about the suprachiasmatic nucleus.
